key_patterns: The script uses ComfyUI NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS to instantiate pipeline components. The mainLTXDirector function (line ~630) orchestrates a two-pass pipeline: Pass 1 (base sampling at 0.5x downscale) then Pass 2 (refine sampling at 1x). LTXDirectorGuide has max_frames and overlap parameters that control batching internally. Memory management uses del + torch.cuda.empty_cache() + gc.collect(). The reference script ltx2_ti2v_distilled.py generates 121 frames at 480p on T4.
